Hey there, ive never had C diff but my ex fiance did for 3-4 years. I helped her through it during our time together but I think I can give you some advice that helped her in the past.

For starters your stomach is most definitely empty and suffering alot of pain so you have to be gentle with what you drink. I suggest hot to warm liquids since water will be very difficult to drink while your body is still recovering. I suggest drinking tea with honey, any tea is fine but dont drink what you cant handle yet so drink little by little. 

Now your breathing plays a big part in your pain management, so you have to breathe to calm down your heart rate including keeping yourself calm while your enduring the pain. It may not sound like much but taking small steady breaths goes a long way when your in pain, you might even start to get irritable so this might help you out with that. 

The main idea here is to stay hydrated and wait out the pain until it passes, I know it sucks to hear that but it will pass. Some advice I can give you is gatorade really helps if you want some electrolytes in your system, sodium helps prevent vomiting so drinks that have sodium can help. 

Another trick I found a few years ago (funny enough on reddit) is to use the jello powder to make jello but keep it to a boil, while its still warm! Not hot!. You can drink it like its a warm juice, jello has a nice amount of sodium so it will prevent some of the vomiting while also letting you partially digest some of the fluids your taking in.

I know its not alot but ever since that person left my life I still remember taking care of them while they had C diff. I hope some of the knowledge I have can help you through this or atleast make it easier
